title: Mike Baretz - "Worth It"
htmlContent:
American producer Mike Baretz shares a wonderful single called "Worth It". The single "Worth It" showcase his beautiful vocals and outstanding songwriting skills. Follow-up of his recently released single "Take It That Way," with a utilized forward-driving beats and woozy atmospherics to create a unique pop sound.

His newest single, "Worth It" is the music you hear, that not only sounds good but picks you up as well. The music is more daring than ever, with his unapologetic writing that people will feel everywhere, as he takes control to make something powerful. The track "Worth It" kicks off with a finger-picked guitar with crackles and snaps like a worn vinyl. This transitions into a simple skittering beat, but his falsetto and jazz-inspired chord progressions add a whole new dimension. 

Mike Baretz shines like the star he is and delivers a supreme track that his fans everywhere have come accustomed to. Hit play now on this special record and enjoy the vibes.
